description: Use this when the user asks what is on one of their XcutAI canvases: its items (imported posts, notes, chats, groups, Meta ads, analytics tables, websites, media) with ids, counts by type and short previews. Filter with `item_type`; paginate with `offset`. Free. Do not use to read an item in full (use xcut_get_content).

item_type.description: Only list this kind of item.
item_type.title: Item Type

offset.description: Items to skip, for paging through a large canvas. Default 0.
offset.title: Offset

name: xcut_get_canvas
title: Get a canvas
